dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' structures on the mid-lateral flank exhibit irregular, high-contrast white perimeters with a rapid gradient transition into dark-grey central voids.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of high-intensity white pixel clusters arranged in linear streaks along the upper dorsal ridge, with lower spatial density of isolated pixel-blobs on the posterior-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli located on the mid-anterior section form a distinct triangular spatial relationship.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brownish-red pigment cluster visible on the ventral margin near the mid-point of the body length.
other_distinctive_markers: Primary longitudinal feature consists of an elongated, high-contrast white jagged line tracing the dorsal ridge.
